tried.text: Not a thing. The transmission is running great right now. It's been maintained properly, and there's no sign of any issues. If you drive it regularly, it'll be just fine for a while.

Yes, the transmission in the 2015 Honda Civic slips when the engine is cold. I know this because it's a known issue with that model. I'm not hiding it, but I'm also not selling it to you because the repair is costly and the car is one sale short of my monthly quota.
